title: Matched sealed pockets cancel common pressure only under actual force boundaries
statement: With Va=Va0-(1+epsilon)q,Vb=Vb0+(1-epsilon)q, restoring pressure is (1+epsilon)(pa-Pamb)-(1-epsilon)(pb-Pamb)+k_total*q/A2. Ambient terms require real outer pressure forces and virtual-work geometry, not numerical subtraction. Equal areas/fill and q0 cancel common T exactly in the ideal-gas model. At nonzero q the gas spring P0(T/T0)[V/(V-q)-V/(V+q)] survives. Different temperatures, fill, permeation and geometry do not cancel; the earlier single-pocket law is unchanged.
